items.title: Welcome
items.text:
Hubuum is a flexible, open-source configuration management database. Define classes, store authoritative and reference data, choose JSON Schema validation or schema-free JSON, and connect objects through relations.

Get started or join the community.

items.title: Build Hubuum with us
items.text: Hubuum is developed in the open and licensed under MIT. Documentation fixes, reproducible bug reports, integration experience, and code contributions help make it useful across different environments.

items.title: Find the right repository
items.text:
• Server: data model, API, permissions, and operations.
  • Frontend: browser workflows and frontend deployment.
  • CLI: terminal commands, scripts, and extensions.
  • Rust client: Rust APIs and client behavior.
  • Python client: Python APIs and client behavior.
  • Ecosystem website: this landing page and its content.
  • Shared documentation tooling: theme, site checks, and publishing workflows.

Use the affected project's issue tracker for questions and bugs. Include the project version, server version where relevant, what you expected, and a small reproduction. Remove tokens, passwords, and private inventory data from examples.

items.title: Propose a change
items.text:
Read the project's contributor instructions and compatibility policy first. Keep documentation with the component that owns the behavior; link to shared server concepts instead of maintaining copies in each client guide.

For a documentation correction, select the development edition and use its edit link. Released documentation remains an immutable record of its source snapshot.

Report security vulnerabilities through the affected repository's private security-reporting channel and published security policy.

items.title: Choose your starting point
items.text: Your goal Start here Then explore Understand whether Hubuum fits your organization Server documentation The data model, permissions, and integration contracts Evaluate a complete installation Server deployment guides Frontend deployment Run and recover a service Server administration Monitoring, identity, backups, and upgrades Work from a terminal CLI installation and guides Search, output pipelines, extensions, and examples Build a Rust integration Rust client Client setup, querying, and generated API reference Build Python automation Python client Synchronous and asynchronous APIs, credentials, and tasks Contribute a change Community and contributing The contributor guide in the affected repository

items.title: Start with a server
items.text:
The frontend, CLI, and libraries connect to a Hubuum server. Production server installations use PostgreSQL. Choose a deployment method from the server guides, configure an administrator and access permissions, then connect the interface that suits your workflow.

The frontend is an application with its own server and session storage. GitHub Pages hosts these documentation sites; deploy the application using the frontend's deployment instructions.

items.title: Keep versions explicit
items.text: A client version does not imply the same server version. Read the compatibility record for the release you deploy, including any credential-approval or backup format requirements. Share an exact /vX.Y.Z/ documentation URL when discussing an older release; use main only when working on unreleased behavior.
